dialogSubtitle: A few quick steps and you are ready to start.

storage.title: Choose a storage location
storage.desc: Videos, subtitles, and offline models all live in the same folder.
storage.unavailable: This folder is not usable right now. Please pick another one.
storage.note: Offline models are large (hundreds of MB to over 1 GB), so pick a location with plenty of space. You can change it later in Settings → Storage.

models.title: Offline Speech & Subtitles
models.desc: Pronunciation and subtitle recognition run on your device. Download once, then they work offline.
models.ttsDesc: Reads words and example sentences aloud, synthesized offline.
models.transcriptionDesc: Turns speech in your videos into subtitles, entirely on your device.
models.transcriptionDownloadFailed: Failed to download the recognition model
models.manualGuideTitle: Download not working? Manual install guide
models.manualStep1: 1. Open the link below in your browser and download:
models.manualStep3Hint: Once saved, come back and click Download; the app finishes the installation automatically.
models.downloadNote: Downloads can be resumed. If your network is slow, you can also download later in Settings → Services & Models.

translation.title: Translation & Lookups
translation.desc: Pick one setup — you can fine-tune it later in Settings → Features.
translation.hardwareHint: Detected {{memory}} GB RAM and {{cores}} CPU cores; we suggest "{{tier}}".

cloud.title: Cloud model
cloud.desc: Best quality, needs an API key

translation.sentenceLearningHint: See a sentence's structure, grammar and usage; requires a cloud model.
translation.localMtDesc: Translates subtitles into Chinese only — fastest and lightest, with more literal wording.
translation.localLlmDesc: More natural, fluent translations; supports simplified English and custom styles, and can look up words beyond the built-in list.
translation.openaiKeyPlaceholder: Enter a key starting with sk-
translation.openaiModelHint: Enter a model name supported by your provider; translation and lookups will use it.
translation.cloudIncompleteHint: Fill in the API key and model name to finish.
translation.localMtDownloadFailed: Failed to download the quick translation model
translation.localModelDownloadFailed: Failed to download the local model

done.title: You're all set!
done.desc: Setup is complete. Here are two quick tips to get you started.

tutorial.title: How to Open Videos & Subtitles
tutorial.desc: Master the two most convenient ways to import media and start learning:
tutorial.method1Desc: Click 'Open Folder' on the home page and select a directory containing your videos and subtitles. DashPlayer links them automatically.
tutorial.method1Tip: 💡 Tip: Keep video and subtitle files in the same folder with matching names, e.g. movie.mp4 and movie.srt.
tutorial.method2Title: Method 2: Multi-select video and subtitle files
tutorial.method2Desc: Click 'Open File', then in the system file picker hold Ctrl / Command to select both the video file (.mp4/.mkv, etc.) and the subtitle file (.srt/.vtt, etc.).
tutorial.method2Tip: 💡 Tip: Selecting both at once automatically binds the subtitles and loads the player.
